description: Department of Local Government - North Western Province - Planing roads, Paths and Publishing Notifications Specifying the name list of roads and Paths maintained by the Pradeshiya Sabhas in the North Western Province
reasoning: This gazette primarily deals with land and property-related matters, specifically the identification, registration, and management of roads and paths by Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies). It outlines procedures for creating official lists of roads, collecting geographical coordinate data, preparing plans and registers, and publishing notifications about road ownership - all falling under land administration and property management. While it involves government bodies, the core content is specifically about land/property matters rather than government structure or personnel changes.
